description: This file defines a utility class 'Image_Canvas_Tool' containing static methods for font mapping, geometric calculations, and Bezier curve computations used in image processing within the Image_Canvas package.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_Tool
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for font mapping, geometric calculations, and Bezier curve operations in image processing.

methods.name: fontMap
methods.description: Maps a font name to its corresponding font file, searching in predefined locations and using a font map file.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns the average of two points.

methods.name: mirror
methods.description: Mirrors a point P1 across P2 by a specified factor.

methods.name: controlPoint
methods.description: Calculates a Bezier control point based on two points and a smoothing factor.

methods.name: bezier
methods.description: Calculates a point on a Bezier curve given four control points and a parameter t.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Calculates the angle in degrees of a line segment relative to the horizontal axis.
